claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament will take place from April 6–12, 2026, at Augusta National Golf Club.
Practice rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament begin on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The 2026 Masters Tournament’s four main competitive rounds run from Thursday, April 9, 2026, through Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Practice rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are April 6–8, 2026.
Par 3 Contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament is Wednesday, April 8, 2026.
Tournament Rounds (1-4) for the 2026 Masters Tournament are April 9–12, 2026.
The Masters Tournament is held annually during the first full week of April.
